title: Alias gate's len==0 skip leaves the health.*/era_gate.* pins inert, contradicting the "pins EVERY owned Run_State dynamic array" claim
detail: All 9 health.* + 5 era_gate.* pin calls hit the len==0 early return (flags never enabled in fixture), so a future missed shadow_clone line for those arrays — which hold allocated cap-4 buffers whose delete frees live memory, the exact shipped bug class — passes CI; the every-array claim is overstated.
recommended_fix: Skip only when raw_data(a) == nil (true no-op deletes), or set s.health_enabled = true (and advance_gate_enabled) in the fixture so every pinned array is non-empty and the gate's completeness claim holds.

title: Regression leg crosses 5 spawn windows but performs only ONE spawn-building connection; AC's "connects >= 5 spawns" is met in spirit (re-predicts), not letter
evidence: Briefing AC 2: "a test/sim leg that connects >= 5 spawns across place/promote/teardown/resplice cycles — MUST crash (or fail the allocator check) RED before the fix and pass GREEN after". The leg connects once — app/render/spawn_fx_test.odin:332-333: "case 2:\n\t\t\tdraw := sfx_connect_newest(&s, &cat)" — the only Cmd_Draw_Pipe in the five windows (w1 place, w2 connect, w3 resplice, w4 teardown, w5 demolish). The assertion redefines the count as windows: :393 "testing.expectf(t, spawns >= 5, \"the leg must cross >= 5 spawn windows: got %d\", spawns)".
detail: The AC's literal wording asks for >= 5 spawn-building connections; the leg makes one connection but forces the crash-relevant re-predict 5 times. RED-before-fix was independently reproduced (2 tests fail, 'bad free @ box.odin:44/45'), so intent is satisfied; only the letter deviates.
recommended_fix: Either connect the newest spawn in several windows (w2 plus post-spawn connects in w3/w4) or record the window-crossing reading as the sanctioned interpretation of the AC in the PR body.
